entities.summary: Ludolf-Hermann Emmanuel Georg Kurt Werner von Alvensleben was a Schutzstaffel (SS) functionary of Nazi Germany. He held positions of SS and Police Leader in occupied Poland and the Soviet Union, and was indicted for war crimes including the killing of at least 4,247 Poles by units under his command.
